entries.evidence: The Beginning and the End Rank Needed: 1 Mana Cost: 0 Mana Cooldown: 5 Seconds Type: Magical Range: An infinite range attack that deals damage to 1 target. Description: Begin the cycle anew by summoning The Fool, increasing your Damage Resistance by 80% for 122 seconds. entries.target: An infinite range attack that deals damage to 1 target.
entries.officialDescription: If The Fool is present, summon an Arcana. Arcana are summoned in a set order, with each one granting you a new effect and the effects of all previously summoned Arcana. Each time an Arcana is summoned, your Damage Resistance is reduced by 2% until The World is summoned.
notes: All Arcana Buffs continue to stay active during The World.
entries.evidence: Arcana Invocation Rank Needed: 2 Mana Cost: 0 Mana Cooldown: 3 Seconds Type: Magical Range: An infinite range attack that deals damage to 1 target. Description: If The Fool is present, summon an Arcana. Arcana are summoned in a set order, with each one granting you a new effect and the effects of all previously summoned Arcana. Each time an Arcana is summoned, your Damage Resistance is reduced by 2% until The World is summoned. If The World is active, instead applies End of the World for 8 seconds, increasing the damage of this skill, but reducing your Damage Resistance by 4% for each stack. Recovers 15 mana on hit. Can't miss. Notes: All Arcana Buffs continue to stay active during The World. Deals 60% magical damage.
